_source: TC-M6-05-s-e1c registration slice. Id contract: docs/content-mapping.csv row Thaumcraft:ench_haste (kind=enchantment). The row names the enchantment that recipe.202.infusion_enchantment.json (original_key InfEnchHaste) puts on the pedestal item; the original applies it to foot armour, so the payload keys on the vanilla foot-armor applicability tag.
